<h3>Presumptive Laws Dashboard</h3><span class="tag tag--wip">under construction</span>

A state-by-state legislative history of first responder presumptive workers' compensation laws — which conditions are presumed work-related, for whom, and since when — with the statute text traced to primary sources rather than advocacy summaries. Built to make a scattered legal landscape legible to researchers and practitioners in one view.
